instruction: Now you are facing towards the grey chair and wooden door, take slight right turn, you can see the open door, exit the open door, take immediate left turn, you can see the wooden door again, enter into that door, now you are in the bedroom, take slight left turn and move forward, in-front you can see the glass door exit the glass door, now you are in the balcony, in-front you can see the glass railing, that is your final destination.
